scope: Audit this analyst memo against the supplied source files. Some statements can be correct, incorrect, or not identifiable; give item-level judgments, corrected calculations and implications for hypotheses.

items.claim: The time column is in milliseconds, so the sample interval is 0.003333 milliseconds and the sampling frequency is 300000 Hz.
The notebook defines inverse correlation length as width[1]/width. Therefore when width doubles, inverse correlation length doubles too.
There are 2199 temporal samples. That does not establish 2199 independent physical realizations.
A fitted power-law slope over this single finite record proves a universal asymptotic exponent, independent of size and preparation.
